svg_layout_metrics(svg) works from the SVG alone, so its enzyme distance is between node-rect centres recovered from the markup, not the model's x/y; the two agree except for rounding to 0.1 px (the unit test allows 2 px on enzyme_link_max and asserts equal counts).
open_questions: Reverse-direction SBGN check (logged by V7a, reviewer note 3): NOT built. It needs the SBGN glyph -> entity and arc source/target parsing that lives in V7a's consistency.py (not merged into this base, outside this lane's boundary); a second parser here would duplicate it. Proposed home: a function in V7a's consistency.py once it is merged: for each regulatory PWML/SBML interaction (left acts on right), the SBGN arc between the regulator glyph and the target's process must run regulator -> process; flag the reversed arcs.

Label fit uses the diagram renderer's 12 px font metric against PathWhiz's label box widths (160 for template 15, 200 for 235, 5 px margin each side). PathWhiz's own label font size is not recorded in the repo, so labels_too_wide is an estimate of the same kind as the renderer's own text-width estimate, not a measurement of PathWhiz.
